_comment: CDP Tools replay sequence. Load with: replay({ action: "load", filename: "<this-file>" }), then run with: replay({ action: "run", name: "<this-file>" }). What the app did under each step, and the responses that answer it on replay, are in the file of the same name under activity/.
name: socket-reconnect
description: Retry until the connection is back: each refused retry runs this sequence again, one level deeper

commands.comment: a refused retry opens and is closed again within a few ms
still offered means this retry was refused, so try again
